sources.title: Kimi K3: 2.8T Open Model for Coding & Knowledge Work
sources.snippet: Kimi K3 is an open 2.8T-parameter model built on our Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, with native vision and a 1M-token context window, designed for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and reasoning. It turns a prompt into playable games, polished presentations, and interactive research reports, even taking on technical work once reserved for experts.

sources.title: Kimi K3 | OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: We introduce Kimi K3 — our most capable model. Kimi K3 is a 2.8T-parameter model built on our Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, with native vision capabilities and a 1-million-token context window. It is the world’s first open 3T-class model, designed for frontier intelligence across long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and reasoning.
